decisions.reason: The candidate already records exactly these two main-board input connectors with the same families, pitches, and pin counts; the source introduces no change to its current state.
This candidate governs the separate power-board-to-main-board power and signal connectors, not the main-board-to-sensor-board connectors identified by the source.
The source concerns the two sensor-board interconnects and does not alter any panel control, touch, button, reset, or panel-power connector behavior.
The candidate already identifies J_SENSOR_PWR as the main-to-sensor power link; specifying its connector construction does not change the power rails, chain order, or distribution behavior.
The shared JST-PH terminology is incidental; the source describes J_SENSOR_PWR and J_SENSOR_SIG rather than the power-board battery connector.
The number and physical types of sensor-board interconnects do not change the monitored rails, monitor IC, channel allocation, or downstream-current coverage.
The source does not concern the charge-status circuit, J_LED_CHG, its resistor configuration, or the main-board status indicator.
The source identifies sensor-board power and signal connectors and does not alter the panel power button, PWRON signal, or J_PWR_BTN connection.
The source does not change the SPS30 SEL-to-GND requirement or its I2C operating mode.
The source specifies connector identities and physical formats but no ESP32 GPIO assignment.
The sensor-board connector inventory does not alter the SK6812 supply voltage, data-level handling, model, or power-control separation.
The source does not change standalone USB activation, the LDO selection or capacity, or the powered scope during sensor debugging.
